provenance.pixels: real — DOTA-v1.0 aerial imagery (aerial, roughly 0.1-1 m — NOT the 10 m Sentinel-2 GSD the orbital layer models. Briefs generated from these tiles must not inherit Sentinel-2 footprint fields.)
provenance.geolocation: approximate — SGP4 propagation of SENTINEL-2C (NORAD 60989) gives a real ground track, but the footprint box assumes Sentinel-2's 10 m GSD, not this tile's actual aerial GSD. Do not treat as measured geolocation.
